name: Duneripper's Scales
lines: (5 items) While you are Bracing, your Physical and Spell Resistance are increased by 5310.

name: Durok's Bane
lines: (5 items) When you take damage, you apply Major Defile to the enemy for 5 seconds, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by 12%. This effect can occur once every 7 seconds per enemy.

name: Eagle Eye
lines: (3 items) Adds 1652 Critical Chance to your ranged direct damage abilities.

name: Earthgore
lines: (2 items) When you heal yourself or a group member that is under 50% Health, you conjure a pool of blood underneath them, immediately removing all harmful area effects, and healing the lowest Health group member in the area after 2 seconds for 1702 Health every 2 seconds over 8 seconds. This effect can occur once every 20 seconds and scales off the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina.

name: Ebon Armory
lines: (5 items) Increases Max Health by 1000 for you and up to 11 other group members within 28 meters of you. This bonus persists through death.

name: Elemental Catalyst
lines: (5 items) Whenever you deal Flame, Shock, or Frost Damage, you apply a stack of Flame, Shock, or Frost Weakness to the enemy for 3 seconds, respective to the damage type dealt. Each stack of an Elemental Weakness increases Critical Damage taken by 5%. An enemy can only have one stack of each Elemental Weakness at a time.

name: Elemental Succession
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Whenever you deal Flame, Shock, or Frost Damage, you gain 492 Weapon and Spell Damage for Flame, Shock, or Frost Damage for 4 seconds. Each effect is picked randomly and an effect that is already active cannot refresh.

name: Elf Bane
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) While in combat, increases the duration of your Flame Damage over Time abilities by 5 seconds. This effect does not work with beam or channeled effects. Applies to Dragonknight Standard.
